required_work.description: Establish the authoritative current NVID status and its commercial consequence.
Check the activation gates and supporting records for completeness and current validity.
Compare the COI dates and gate output to isolate the remaining material blocker.
Determine what PO preparation is complete and whether the draft may be commercially released.
Specify the evidence and controlled review needed to clear the activation blocker.
Communicate what is complete, what remains open, the authority boundary, and the next owners.

optional_work.description: Prepare a concise request for current insurance evidence without representing the vendor as approved.
If the business elects to request an exception, assess it only under Northstar's documented, time-limited approval requirements; no such request or approval currently exists.

acceptable_groupings: Vendor-standing review and onboarding-evidence review may be combined.
Blocker identification and remediation definition may be combined.
Draft-PO readiness may be included in the final status summary or handled as a separate Procurement work item.
Visible COI date extraction may be separated from the policy-based validity and standing decision.
unnecessary_work: A full food-safety or regulatory investigation when no R3 or Q&R blocker is present.
PO delivery-performance or OTIF analysis before a commercial PO has been issued.
A broad review of unrelated category-reset materials.
Revalidation of AP banking details when AP's owned gate is already PASS.
